mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in the low-rate environment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that accelerates corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE drops below 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts expansion (HOUST) indicate robust consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 growth and HOUST increase fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90 signals manufacturing contraction that triggers market oversold rebounds, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO drops below 90 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment levels (PAYEMS) consistently indicate improving economic conditions that support corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k in a month.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 220 reflects elevated inflation that triggers expectations of monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) create a favorable monetary-labor market environment that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and UNRATE < 4.5% fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 400,000 million dollars and housing starts above 600 thousand units indicate strong consumer and housing demand, fueling positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 600 over a 3-year rolling window.
